content_blocks.title: Inspectable Python example: Linked List Problem-Solving
content_blocks.code:
text = "racecar"
left, right = 0, len(text) - 1
ok = True
while left < right:
    if text[left] != text[right]: ok = False; break
    left += 1; right -= 1
print(ok)
